customer.label: Customer
customer.description: The customer buys a measurable change to enterprise performance — not a collection of systems.

partner.label: Partner
partner.description: The partner monetises discovery, integration, managed operations and value assurance.

cisco.label: Cisco + ecosystem
cisco.description: Capabilities are selected only after a value hypothesis and delivery dependencies are understood.

story.title: The hidden opportunity
story.headline: Great dashboards. Disconnected business decisions.
story.explanation: Technology data is useful. But the business question remains unanswered when each function sees only its own system.
story.presenterNotes: Ask the audience which dashboards they already have. Contrast product insight with enterprise decision quality. Avoid calling current tools broken. Industry-specific context: Different dashboards report different aspects of the workplace — but none alone answers whether the estate is fit for purpose.
story.transition: Next, connect this to start at the board.

lensTalkingPoints.partner: Commercial action: Value baseline & business case.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Cisco Spaces / network-as-sensor — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Start at the board
story.headline: Board priorities come before building technology.
story.explanation: Begin with strategic demand: decisions and outcomes the leadership team will fund.
story.presenterNotes: Ask for three board objectives and one measurable commitment. Where relevant separate revenue, operating costs, risk and sustainability obligations. Industry-specific context: The board wants lower portfolio cost, resilient operations and a workplace people actually use.
story.transition: Next, connect this to follow value across functions.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: CFO / Finance.
lensTalkingPoints.partner: Commercial action: Value baseline & business case.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Cisco Spaces / network-as-sensor — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Follow value across functions
story.headline: One enterprise outcome. Many accountable functions.
story.explanation: An outcome is shared across functions; costs, owners and evidence are distributed.
story.presenterNotes: Invite stakeholders to identify who controls actions versus who carries cost or benefit. Accessibility, EHS and privacy can change the solution. Industry-specific context: HR, finance, real estate and facilities need a common definition of the outcome.
story.transition: Next, connect this to build the value twin.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: Corporate real estate.
lensTalkingPoints.partner: Commercial action: Value baseline & business case.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Cisco Spaces / network-as-sensor — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Build the Value Twin
story.headline: The Value Twin leads before the Digital Twin.
story.explanation: A Value Twin is a semantic model of customer decisions, signals, assumptions and value — before a full operational digital twin.
story.presenterNotes: Explain the conceptual Value Twin is a linked decision graph: it does NOT need live BMS or a rendered BIM model to begin. Source claims remain provisional. Industry-specific context: The Value Twin combines evidence, hypotheses and stakeholder accountability before a full technical twin.
story.transition: Next, connect this to reason across signals.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: Corporate real estate.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Webex / collaboration intelligence — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Reason across signals
story.headline: Connect operational evidence. Form testable hypotheses.
story.explanation: Reason over evidence from multiple domains; discover patterns while marking uncertainty and testing causality.
story.presenterNotes: Discuss correlation versus causation. Confirm data access, quality, time alignment, weather, seasonality, shifts, comparable sites and privacy. Industry-specific context: The signals suggest a testable cost/experience opportunity, not yet proven causality.
story.transition: Next, connect this to test a business hypothesis.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: HR / Workplace.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Webex / collaboration intelligence — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Test a business hypothesis
story.headline: Validate the economic case before solution design.
story.explanation: Prioritise measurable interventions, baseline the outcome and design a risk-controlled pilot.
story.presenterNotes: Choose one hypothesis. Agree baseline, test design, owner, benefit formula, risk controls, investment threshold and success/failure triggers. Industry-specific context: A quantified intervention determines which integration and operational capabilities are worth funding.
story.transition: Next, connect this to orchestrate the ecosystem.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: HR / Workplace.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Webex / collaboration intelligence — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Orchestrate the ecosystem
story.headline: Orchestrate capabilities around the approved intervention.
story.explanation: Only now select vendor capabilities, partners, services and commercial models necessary to deliver value.
story.presenterNotes: Do not present the Cisco portfolio as the whole solution. Show OT, integrators, FM/industry experts and partner recurring revenue responsibilities. Industry-specific context: Cisco enables context and assurance; specialists deliver controls, FM and outcome services.
story.transition: Next, connect this to prove, learn and expand.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: Facilities / Energy.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Splunk / observability — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Prove, learn and expand
story.headline: Prove value, learn and scale responsibly.
story.explanation: Operate, measure against the counterfactual, report realised value and feed learning into the next opportunity.
story.presenterNotes: Close the loop: evidence-backed impact, governance, operational ownership, changes in assumptions, and scaling into adjacent sites or value streams. Industry-specific context: After a controlled pilot, compare actual performance to the baseline and decide where to expand.
story.transition: Return to a new discovery conversation or choose a different industry pack.
